Package repository

Interface Repository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>

Type Parameters:
ID - the type of the entity id
E - the type of the entity, which must have an id of type ID
All Known Subinterfaces:
FriendshipRepository, UserRepository
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractFileRepository, FriendshipDbRepository, FriendshipFileRepository, InMemoryFriendshipRepository, InMemoryRepository, InMemoryUserRepository, UserDbRepository, UserFileRepository
public interface Repository<ID,E extends Entity<ID>>
Generic CRUD repository for entities. Implementations decide where the entities are stored (memory, file, database); the layers above depend only on this contract, and the concrete implementation is chosen by RepositoryFactory from the configuration.
